Base

Released January 9, 1999 · 102 cards

Base is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Base series, released in English on January 9, 1999. It has 102 cards. It includes 69 Pokémon, 26 Trainer and 7 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.
